execution_route: Shared core.flight.cli campaign over the committed single-cell campaign plan configs/campaign/slurp-native-stage3-rollout-r01-v1.json; the campaign acquires its own GenerationLease against the resident session and schedules the one official score at finalize. Queued through the SAEA-Batch-Driver scheduled task (decision 77).

modules.base: the LOCKED v2.0 default plan (cell PLAN, sealed arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-V1): the complete native episode with the review loop on, the shared rails.controllers.EvidenceAgentController through core.flight.FlightRuntime and the same OpenJiuwen executor, Solver-only answer authority, the slot-contracts v2 store, the train-exemplars store at k = 20, the intent-boundaries store, the np4 x 24,576 max512 resident geometry and the scorers. Nothing of it moves except the enumerated factor.
modules.factor: ONE factor against the locked v2.0 default plan (cell PLAN, configs/baseline/slurp-native-default-plan-lock-baseline-v1.json): native_episode.roles.solver.samples = 5 with decoding_overrides = {temperature: 0.7, seed_offset: 0} and commit = {policy: saea-commit-plurality-support-v1, min_support: 3, similarity_threshold: 0.8} -- the sealed B2 v3 grouped-Solver form -- and native_episode.deliver_normaliser REMOVED, because rails.native_episode_config refuses a grouped Solver together with the delivery normaliser node; the v3 projection moves to S3-3's offline scoring instead. The roster is the S3-1 construction roster SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01 (800 TRAIN construction rows) rather than TRAIN Fold A, with that roster's own promoted featcache packets and its own two query-vector pins. Everything else -- knowledge_stores.slot-contracts, phase_material, the task instruction template, the np4 x 24,576 geometry, the scorers -- is byte-identical to cell PLAN, and tests/unit/test_stage3_rollout_baseline_cell.py is the byte proof. Every sample is custodied in solver_group (invariant I7g); the delivered answer is the plurality commit and is read for nothing but custody.
modules.roster_is_part_of_the_factor: the S3-1 construction roster SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01 (800 TRAIN construction rows, roster receipt docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-construction-r01.json, split identity 2ece5e51ff781fdec89bef8e7448d8ba88249030d3c8a6478dba5e7c1e621dac) replaces TRAIN Fold A, with its own promoted featcache packets (SAEA-SN-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01-PREPROCESS-RECOVERY-V1), its own intent-boundary speech-query vectors (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01-SPEECH-QUERY-ENCODING-V1) and its own model-free content derivative (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01-QUERY-VECTOR-EXPORT-V1). All three are sealed and pinned by hash in the baseline fragment; no comparator is defined on this roster.
modules.declared_keys_that_are_not_factors: native_episode.finite_completion_policy = deliver-latest-or-abstain (item E13) and native_episode.react_exhaustion_policy = continue-without-answer (item E22), both required of every live SLURP native cell by scripts/checks/finite_completion_policy_check.py. Neither renders a request byte; each only decides whether a finite completion or a ReAct exhaustion aborts the flight or the row is RETAINED with its terminal disposition.
modules.zero_tool_authority: no role carries phase_tools; the native task-contract call ceiling is 0 and no tools array is rendered on any request (item E23 repair form 0-B).
modules.purpose: Cell ROLL-1 (S3-2): produce five custodied Solver samples per row of the S3-1 construction roster so that S3-3 can score the copies and select the best/worst pair on every disagreeing row, and S3-4 can ask the frozen core what distinguished the better answer from the worse. No admission verdict is read from this cell. Stage-3 algorithm label (owner decision 101): shared-rollout, operator rollout -- the algorithm-neutral rollout operator whose five custodied Solver samples per row every layer-A family (Training-Free GRPO, GEPA, ACE) consumes; it applies no learned context of its own. Declared as stage3_algorithm in both experiment fragments and checked by scripts/checks/stage3_algorithm_label_check.py.

prepared_phase_supply.note: NOT built by this registration and deliberately NOT pinned here. core.flight.repin builds this cell's OWN model-free artifact under its own run id at the readiness flip (item E16: a prepared artifact is evidence only for the implementation that produced it, so nothing is inherited from cell PLAN or from B2 v3), then pins it into configs/baseline/slurp-native-stage3-rollout-baseline-v1.json and into the experiment fragment's 'preparation' readiness requirement, which carries PENDING placeholders until then. No relpath or sha256 is written into these plans, because with no current pin the re-pin tool builds no old-value mapping and would leave a placeholder here forever. --allow-output-change must never be passed.

quality_read_gate: No read of any kind before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 800 outputs with five custodied solver_group samples per row (invariant I7g) and the native phase summary all exist. There is no admission read and no comparator: the only read is S3-3's own CLI (scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py) on COPIES of the sealed outputs, model-free, and the row accounting 800 in / 800 out must hold on both sides before any pair is selected.
